game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the fire warden must hold off cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: In Ember Fields, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats. Then check power and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from cinder bats in Ember Fields: keep power above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 5, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
